status_label: Confirm live on the official portal only
window_note: These dates appear in guide pack metadata and secondary reports only. They are NOT a live official confirmation of open/closed status. Always check portal.nelf.gov.ng for your account and institution.
rules: Never invent open/closed from WhatsApp, blogs, or static guide files alone.
National window open does not mean every school session is open.
Reachable official website ≠ verified application-window declaration.
Account creation can work while loan request is still closed for a student or school.
Individual eligibility is separate from whether a cycle window is open.
note: Status answers must always point students to portal.nelf.gov.ng to see whether Request Loan is available on their account. School-side session blocks can still show even when a national window is open.
